title: swap321
tagline: A platform to connect users with one another who want to exchange crypto and/or fiat
description: This project connects end users who are looking to exchange different currencies with each other. Users can chat with one another and exchange crypto for fiat or vice versa. This project will use web3auth wallet for users to be able to easily log in. Users can post orders about crypto they would like exchanged. Individuals looking to purchase crypto using crypto or fiat can see the orders and send crypto over the blockchain or fiat over payment providers such as PayPal.
how_its_made: This project uses web3auth to make the login process simple and only require an email address. XMTP will be used to provide a chat interface where users can chat with users who have posted ads prior to trading. Chainlink will be used to fetch the latest pricing information for conversions. Ethereum blockchain will be used to transfer crypto and PayPal is used to transfer fiat.
